visual_direction: GlassPlay hero & brand evolution: the playful side of smart glasses. Little unexpected moments; more than meets the eye.

source.description: Owner-supplied reference artwork approved as the new GlassPlay creative direction (1672x941 PNG).
source.creation_method: Not documented in this repository; recorded as supplied by the owner.

operations: Removed the baked-in 'GlassPlay' wordmark, trademark sign and tagline by local-contrast masking and inpainting of the defocused wall; the page renders the name and tagline as HTML.
Removed two faint engraved strokes on the right temple so the glasses carry no brand-like mark. The small camera lens near the hinge is a generic functional detail and was kept.
No characters, glasses, lighting or composition were redrawn or added.
Mobile composition: crop (520, 0)-(1672, 820) around the glasses and encounters.
processing.cards_script: scripts/art/glassplay_cards.mjs (social card and README banner; website Manrope type rendered in headless Chrome)

disclosures: The glasses are brand-neutral illustration. They do not depict Raven Prism or any specific device.
The small encounters illustrate the kind of experiences GlassPlay explores; they are not screenshots or claims about display capability.
No trademark sign or brand affiliation is shown.

exports.use: Open Graph / Twitter card for GlassPlay pages
